name: OpenClaw WebOS
description: Control UI tab that mounts the OpenClaw Project WebOS desktop as a Lit ControlUiView (Phase 2). In-repo only — do not install without owner approval.

taskServerUrl.description: Staging task-server URL. Tab uses host.request for Workboard RPCs when served from the Gateway origin; this URL is reserved for a same-host proxy only if proven needed.

desktopTokenGate.description: Optional desktop token gate when the tab is served from the Gateway origin. Default UNCHANGED (off) so :8120 and other origins keep their existing DASHBOARD_AUTH_TOKEN bootstrap.
